title: 環境土木専門実験・演習Ｂ
subtitle: Civil and Environmental Engineering Major Lab/Exercises B
teachers:
HANAOKA Daishin
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Students will learn skills that relate to actual phenomena, and apply those skills through experiments and exercises illustrating geoinformatics, hydraulics, and reinforced concrete engineering.
advice:
We will cover the following topics:
1. Geographic information systems (6 weeks)
2. Flow of water (5 weeks)
3. Behavior of reinforced concrete beams (3 weeks)
4. Overall across-field exercises (1 week)

Details of the schedule are explained during the first lesson.
Students should bring a PC and LAN cable to each class since laptops and the Internet are integral to learning about geographic information systems.
books: Civil and Environmental Engineering Major Lab/Exercises A,B (Japanese)
requiredKnowledge:
1. Students need familiarity with geographic information systems, basic map information, and digital maps
2. Students must understand laminar air flow and turbulent flow, mean fluid velocity and flow velocity distribution, objects’ resistance coefficients, Venturi meters, and the characteristics of waves
3. Students need to be acquainted with the mixture proportion of concrete, compressive strength, and bending of reinforced concrete beams
